Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药箱存放弹道武器所需的弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armour Piercing AC Ammo grants an increased chance for critical hits. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穿甲自动炮弹药提供更高的暴击几率。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caseless autocannon ammunition was developed by the Federated Commonwealth to provide more ammunition. Instead of a standard metal or plastic shell casing filled with propellant, the caseless autocannon round had the propellant 'packed' around the projectile. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 无壳自动炮弹药由联邦联邦开发，以提供更多弹药。无壳弹不用装满发射药的标准金属或塑料弹壳，而是把发射药"包"在弹丸周围。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Doubled Ammo Bins replace one ammo bins feeding and storing mechanism to fit 25% more shots into one location. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双倍弹药箱通过替换单个弹药箱的供弹和储存机构，在同一位置多容纳25%的弹药. 在遭受暴击时，弹药箱内储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可以降低此风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药箱存放弹道武器所需的弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inferno ammunition can be used in standard autocannons and their lighter cousins. Developed by NAIS scientists from the Federated Suns, these autocannon rounds contained an Inferno warhead and were covered in a thin coat of magnesium.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炼狱弹药适用于标准自动炮及其轻型衍生型号. 这款弹药由恒星联邦的 NAIS科学家研发，其自动炮弹头内置燃烧战斗部，并覆有一层薄镁涂层.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Precision AC Ammo carries self-guided gyrojet shells increasing accuracy. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 精确自动炮弹药携带自导火箭增程弹，提升精度。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: C.A.S.E. ammunition bins are designed with blast plates facing away from vital components on a mech. Once sensors have detected an ammunition explosion the plate nearest to the outside is jettisoned. Resulting in much of the explosive potential to expand towards the free space outside and away from the mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: C.A.S.E.弹药箱的设计使其防爆板朝向远离机甲关键元件的方向. 一旦传感器探测到弹药爆炸，最靠近外部的防爆板便会立即抛离，从而让大部分爆炸能量向外部自由空间释放，避开机甲本体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solid Slug ammo is great for training exercises or demolitions work, but is ineffective at dealing damage to mechs or military vehicles. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 实心弹适合训练演习或拆除作业，但对机甲或军用车辆造成伤害效果很差。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Deadfire Rockets are standard Short Range Missile bodies equipped with an upgraded high explosive payload. In order to make room for this additional payload, severe cuts were taken to the weapons onboard guidance system, all but removing it. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 死火火箭是标准近程导弹弹体，装备升级的高爆载荷。为容纳额外载荷，其机载制导系统被大幅削减，几乎完全去除。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Infernos are special fuel-air missile munitions that are a development of the incendiary weapons of the mid-twentieth century. They combine flammable chemicals with an adhesive compound to shower their targets with a burning gel. This gel is designed to increase a 'Mech's heat levels to the point where the DI computer shuts down the 'Mech's Fusion Engine. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃烧弹是特种燃料空气导弹弹药，由二十世纪中期的燃烧武器发展而来。它把可燃化学剂与黏附剂结合，向目标倾泻燃烧凝胶。这种凝胶能把机甲热量推高到让 DI 计算机强制关闭聚变引擎的程度。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though they do inflict damage directly on a target, what makes these missiles so effective is their secondary effects. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A thermobaric or Fuel Air Explosion (FAE) explosion occurs when fuel is aerosolized with a scattering charge and then detonated. The resulting explosion is significantly more energetic than a conventional high explosive of the same mass. While the name suggests an incendiary effect the fuel is detonated not burnt. The heat is immense but of very short duration; however flammable materials are likely to be ignited. Primary damage is caused by the massive blast followed by a near vacuum in the area, which quickly collapses. The shockwaves are devastating to structures and armored units. Exposed personal who are unlucky enough not to be vaporized by the blast often die slowly, lungs and eardrums ruptured by the catastrophic pressure differentials. Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 温压弹或燃料空气弹（FAE）爆炸发生在燃料被散布装药雾化并随后引爆之时。所产生爆炸的能量显著高于同等质量常规高爆药。虽然名称暗示燃烧效果，但燃料是被引爆而非燃烧。热量巨大但持续时间极短；不过易燃物很可能被引燃。主要伤害来自巨大爆轰及其后该区域近乎真空的迅速塌缩。冲击波对建筑与装甲单位具有毁灭性。不幸未被爆轰汽化的暴露人员往往缓慢死去——肺与鼓膜在灾难性压差下破裂。弹药箱装填弹道武器所需弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。一旦受到致命一击，弹药舱内剩余的弹药将会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用C.A.S.E.可降低风险。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜂群导弹系统携带的是小型子弹药而非传统 LRM 弹头，能在目标区域倾泻爆炸物。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tandem-Charge Missiles use a pair of explosives to inflict damage. The first explosive is a shaped charge that penetrates the unit's outer defense, while the second charge is propelled through the newly created breach to damage internal components. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 串联战斗部导弹使用两枚炸药造成伤害。第一枚是穿透该单位外层防御的成型装药，第二枚则被推进新炸开的破口，以损伤内部组件。受到致命一击时，弹药箱内剩余的弹药会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害。使用C.A.S.E.可降低风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In an attempt to improve LRMs, scientists applied a somewhat ancient technique by remodeling the warhead into a shaped charge. This traded the majority of its destructive potential for the ability to punch through nearly any armor at long range on the modern battlefield. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了改进LRM，科学家们采用了一种略显古老的技术，将弹头改造成空心装药。这牺牲了大部分破坏潜力，换来在现代战场上远距离击穿几乎任何装甲的能力。一旦受到致命一击，弹药箱中任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，并对所在位置造成伤害。使用C.A.S.E.可以降低风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Each Thunder LRM missile contains five small but powerful anti-vehicle mines which scatter out when fired, packing enough explosive force to damage the legs of many BattleMechs. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每枚雷霆LRM导弹包含五颗小型但威力强大的反车辆地雷，发射时会散布开来，其爆炸威力足以损伤许多战斗机甲的腿部. 若弹药箱遭到暴击，箱内剩余的弹药将会爆炸，对安装部位造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可降低此风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Grade FASCAM Munitions are mostly equal to IS Augmented Thunder with a finer tuned sensor, being more likely to detonate. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族级布雷弹药大致与内星域增强型“雷霆”布雷弹相当，但配备了更精密的传感器，触发概率更高. 弹药箱遭受暴击时，储存的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装部位造成损伤. 此风险可通过使用C.A.S.E.来降低.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Follow The Leader Warhead (FTL) was developed during the Star League era, this alternate munition for LRM launchers functions like a standard LRM flight in every way except one: When a target is hit, every missile in the flight will hit. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E

【Ammo Narc Explosive】这种高度特化的NARC弹药变体舍弃了寻的组件，换取了一个大型聚能弹头. 弹药箱储存了实弹武器所需的弹药，每种武器类型至少需要一个弹药箱.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This highly specialized variant of the NARC pod strips out the homing components in exchange for a sizable high explosive charge. Upon impact the pod sticks to the target. In order to maximize instability delivered to the target a small gyroscopic sensor detonates when the target shifts it's weight, or, as a failsafe, after a few seconds delay. Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type.Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Infernos are special fuel-air missile munitions that are a development of the incendiary weapons of the mid-twentieth century. They combine flammable chemicals with an adhesive compound to shower their targets with a burning gel. This gel is designed to increase a 'Mech's heat levels to the point where the DI computer shuts down the 'Mech's Fusion Engine. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃烧弹是特种燃料空气导弹弹药，由二十世纪中期的燃烧武器发展而来。它把可燃化学剂与黏附剂结合，向目标倾泻燃烧凝胶。这种凝胶能把机甲热量推高到让 DI 计算机强制关闭聚变引擎的程度。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caseless autocannon ammunition was developed by the Federated Commonwealth to provide more ammunition. Instead of a standard metal or plastic shell casing filled with propellant, the caseless autocannon round had the propellant 'packed' around the projectile. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 无壳自动炮弹药由联邦联邦开发，以提供更多弹药。无壳弹不用装满发射药的标准金属或塑料弹壳，而是把发射药"包"在弹丸周围。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Doubled Ammo Bins replace one ammo bins feeding and storing mechanism to 25% more shots into one location. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双倍弹药箱取代单个弹药箱的供弹与储存机制，将多 25% 的弹药集中在一个部位。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: C.A.S.E. equipped ammunition bins are designed with blast plates facing away from vital components on a mech. Once sensors have detected an ammunition explosion, the plate nearest to the outside is jettisoned. Causing much of the explosive potential to expand towards the free space outside, and away from the mech.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 精确自动炮弹药携带自导火箭增程弹，提升精度。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: C.A.S.E. equipped ammunition bins are designed with blast plates facing away from vital components on a mech. Once sensors have detected an ammunition explosion, the plate nearest to the outside is jettisoned. Causing much of the explosive potential to expand towards the free space outside, and away from the mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 配备 C.A.S.E. 的弹药箱设计有背向机甲要害部件的爆压板。一旦传感器探测到弹药爆炸，最外层的板片会被抛离，使大部分爆炸威力朝机甲外侧的自由空间释放，远离机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药箱存放弹道武器所需的弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Doubled Ammo Bins replace one ammo bins feeding and storing mechanism to 25% more shots into one location. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双倍弹药箱取代单个弹药箱的供弹与储存机制，将多 25% 的弹药集中在一个部位。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solid Slug ammo is great for training exercises or demolitions work, but is ineffective at dealing damage to mechs or military vehicles. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Does not explode.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药箱存放弹道武器所需的弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。不会爆炸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药箱存放弹道武器所需的弹药，每种武器至少需要一个弹药箱。弹药箱受到暴击时，其内剩余弹药会爆炸并对所在部位造成伤害。使用 C.A.S.E. 可以降低此风险。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ammunition is an attempt to make primitive Rifle weapons effective in the face of modern armor. Armor Piercing Fin Stabilized Discarding Sabot munitions have been used for centuries. Essentially a long heavy metal dart they punch through armor using kinetic energy alone; no explosive warhead is used. This means ammo explosions are less dangerous, but their damage decreases at long range. Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种弹药旨在使原始步枪武器在面对现代装甲时依然有效. 穿甲尾翼稳定脱壳弹已使用了数个世纪. 本质上是一根重型长金属箭，仅凭动能穿透装甲; 不使用爆炸弹头. 这意味着弹药爆炸的危险性较低，但其伤害在远距离时会衰减. 弹药箱存放实弹武器所需的弹药，每种武器类型至少需要一个弹药箱. 若弹药箱遭到暴击，箱内剩余的弹药将会爆炸，对安装部位造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可降低此风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Made from ancient Blue Prints, this Rifle Munitions is encased in its propellant to save up space at cost of reliability. Upon receiving a Critical Hit, any remaining ammunition stored inside an Ammo Bin will explode dealing damage to the install location. Risk can be mitigated with the use of C.A.S.E.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种步枪弹药根据古老的蓝图制造，其弹药被封装在推进剂中，以节省空间，但代价是降低可靠性. 当受到暴击时，存放在弹药箱中的任何剩余弹药都会爆炸，对安装位置造成伤害. 使用C.A.S.E.可以降低这种风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In an attempt to keep TBM systems competitive despite the reappearance of AMS these munitions go 'dumb' during part of their flight while dropping chaff. This impairs accuracy and reduces warhead payload slightly, but throws off AMS systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了让 TBM 系统在反导系统重现后仍具竞争力，这类弹药在飞行某阶段会"变傻"并撒布箔条。这降低了精度、略微削减弹头载荷，却能干扰反导系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: High Explosive warhead with AOE and minefield clearance, but low direct damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高爆弹头，具备范围杀伤与清雷能力，但直接伤害低

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These missiles use an unusually large rocket motor with an extended burn time to accelerate a heavy kinetic energy penetrator to great speed. The downside is that it takes time for the projectile to reach peak velocity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这类导弹使用异常巨大的火箭发动机与延长燃烧时间，把重型动能穿甲弹加速到极高速度。缺点是弹丸需要时间才能达到峰值速度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thunderbolts armed with advanced surface-to-seekers and small tandem warheads, excels at engaging low to medium speed air targets
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷霆导弹装备先进面对空导引头和小型串联弹头，擅长对付中低速空中目标
